remarks: Look no further! Spacious, bright & clean one bedroom apartment with a spacious LOFT that could be used as additional bedroom, office or exercise area. Sky lights bring in tons of natural light. Unit also includes 1 full bathroom, living room, kitchen & MORE! Main level bedroom sliders lead to private balcony facing parking area. 1 assigned parking spot. Central air & washer/dryer in unit for your comfort. Beautiful hardwood floors in living area. Pet friendly. Two-level END unit. Entrance in the rear of the building at 454 Main Ave. Plenty of cabinet/storage space. Located minutes from South Wilton, Rt 7, I95, Rt 15 and all that Main Ave has to offer. Commuter friendly. Silvermine Golf Club nearby. Tenants must have good credit, proof of income & references. *Carpet in unit to be replaced prior to lease start date*
